title: Closing a window vs. quitting
drDigitalIntro:
Closing a window and quitting an app are two different things.
• The yellow minus button minimizes the window — it hides it, but the app is still running. You can see it is still open because a green dot appears on the dock icon.
• The red X button closes the window completely. On some apps, this also quits the app.
• Let's see the difference: minimize the window, then bring it back, then close it.

steps.say: Click the yellow minus button to minimize the window.
Click the Notes icon in the dock to bring it back.
Now close it with the red X.

drDigitalSuccess: Now you know the difference — minimize hides, close removes. Great work!
drDigitalHint: Use the yellow minus to minimize, then click the icon in the dock to restore, then the red X to close.
